2 04-12-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Abadpur P.S. Case No. 64 of 2024 was registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 409, 120(B)/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3, 7 of the E.C. Act.

3. According to prosecution case, C.D.P.O office Barsoi vide letter No. - 328 dated 31.05.2024 authorized Aanganbari Sevika Ismat Jaha Khatoon for distribution of 1526 quintal of rice in utter violation of rules which provides that only office staff could be authorized for the purpose.

The C.D.P.O in violation of rules, authorized co-accused Ismat Jaha Khatoon (Aanganbari Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.83738 of 2025(2) dt.04-12-2025 Sevika) for lifting and distribution of rice in which her husband Md. Taiyab was also involved.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in this case due to high handedness of the authorities.

He further submits that petitioner no. 2 has no role at all simply because the tractor in question was found near the PACS godown for which the report of SDO is justified about he standing of the tractor.

The petitioner no. 1 is simply Aanganbari Sevika and the main accused C.D.P.O Anita Kumari had been granted anticipatory bail vide order dated 26.10.2024 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 73696 of 2024 (Annexure - P/3)

in that order in para 4 it has been observed that "Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent Ismat Jahan Aara Khatoon @ Eamat Jahan ... vs The State Of Bihar on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86726444/
1 and has falsely been implicated in this case.

sentences.text: The allegation levelled against the petitioner is not specific rather general and omnibus in nature.

He submits that an inquiry was conducted by the S.D.O., on the direction of the District Magistrate, Katihar in which it is found that the informant without conducting any departmental inquiry or verification manipulated the facts and lodged the present case even without informing about the same to the District Magistrate, Katihar.

He further submits that the petitioner had previously submitted complaint against the informant vide Letter No. 181 dated 26.05.2023 to the District Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.83738 of 2025(2)
dt.04-12-2025 Magistrate, Katihar, due to which the informant always used to unnecessarily harass the petitioner."
The petitioners are wife and husband moreover the recovered entire rice has been handed over to the Block Development Officer, Barsoi as per para 6 of the FIR.
The petitioners have no criminal antecedents as per para 3 of the bail petition.
5. Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail application.
6. Considering the aforesaid fact that there is nothing specific against the petitioners.

Let the above named petitioners, in the event of their arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail- bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned S.D.J.M, 1 st Class, Katihar in connection with Abadpur P.S. Case No. 64 of 2024, subject to conditions as laid down under section 482 (2) of the B.N.S.S.
7.
The application stands allowed.

(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) Siddharth Soni/-
